# Heartbreaker in Monaco: A Romantic-Comedy Location Guide

### The man who broke hearts for a living came to Monaco. Then things became complicated.

Monte Carlo seems like the perfect place for a romantic comedy.

There are luxury hotels, expensive boutiques, elegant restaurants, beautiful cars and Mediterranean views that make almost anything look romantic.

But in L’Arnacœur, the problem isn't finding romance.

It's preventing a wedding.

Released in 2010, Pascal Chaumeil's Heartbreaker stars Romain Duris as Alex Lippi, a professional seducer who specialises in separating couples.

He works with his sister Mélanie and her husband Marc, who help organise the elaborate schemes behind his assignments.

Alex has one professional rule: he only intervenes when he believes a woman is unhappy in her relationship.

Then a wealthy businessman hires him to stop his daughter Juliette from marrying her British fiancé.

Juliette is played by Vanessa Paradis.

She's independent, intelligent, apparently happy and not especially interested in the attentions of a charming stranger.

There's also a deadline.

The wedding is only days away.

So Alex travels to Monaco, where the glamorous surroundings become the setting for increasingly elaborate attempts to win her confidence.

The result is one of the most popular French romantic comedies of its era.

And unlike films that use Monaco merely as an imagined background, Heartbreaker was extensively filmed in the Principality itself.

The Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, the Opéra de Monte-Carlo and streets around Casino Square all played important roles.

This guide explores those real locations and offers a practical way to visit them from Menton.

# L'Arnacœur à Monaco : promenade sur les lieux d'une comédie romantique

Monte-Carlo semble fait pour une comédie romantique : hôtels de luxe, boutiques, voitures élégantes et vues méditerranéennes. Dans L'Arnacœur, pourtant, le problème n'est pas de trouver l'amour, mais d'empêcher un mariage.

Sorti en 2010, le film de Pascal Chaumeil met en scène Alex Lippi, interprété par Romain Duris, un séducteur professionnel qui sépare les couples avec l'aide de sa sœur Mélanie et de son beau-frère Marc. Il prétend n'intervenir que lorsqu'une femme est malheureuse. Puis un riche père l'engage pour empêcher Juliette, jouée par Vanessa Paradis, d'épouser son fiancé britannique.

Juliette est indépendante, intelligente, apparemment heureuse et peu impressionnée par cet inconnu. Le mariage approche. Alex vient donc à Monaco pour organiser des rencontres toujours plus élaborées. Les apparences luxueuses deviennent le décor de ses efforts pour gagner sa confiance.

Contrairement aux films utilisant un Monaco seulement imaginaire, L'Arnacœur y a réellement tourné de nombreuses scènes. Monte-Carlo Bay, la place du Casino et la Salle Garnier sont des lieux documentés. Ce guide propose de les découvrir depuis Menton, en distinguant les lieux confirmés des identifications de contributeurs. Le point de départ et l'histoire du tournage sont présentés sans révéler la fin.

# Heartbreaker a Monaco: guida ai luoghi di una commedia romantica

Monte Carlo sembra fatta per una commedia romantica: hotel di lusso, boutique, belle automobili e panorami mediterranei. In L'Arnacœur, però, il problema non è trovare l'amore, ma impedire un matrimonio.

Nel film del 2010 di Pascal Chaumeil, Romain Duris interpreta Alex Lippi, seduttore professionista che separa le coppie con l'aiuto della sorella Mélanie e del cognato Marc. Sostiene di intervenire soltanto quando una donna è infelice. Poi un ricco padre gli affida il compito di fermare le nozze della figlia Juliette con un fidanzato britannico.

Juliette, interpretata da Vanessa Paradis, è indipendente, intelligente e apparentemente felice. Non sembra interessata a quello sconosciuto, mentre il matrimonio è ormai vicino. Alex arriva a Monaco e organizza tentativi sempre più elaborati di conquistarne la fiducia.

Il lusso diventa il palcoscenico di un mestiere basato sulle apparenze. E Monaco non è soltanto uno sfondo immaginario: Monte-Carlo Bay, Place du Casino e Salle Garnier hanno realmente ospitato le riprese. Questa guida propone una visita da Mentone, distinguendo siti documentati e identificazioni preliminari. Racconta premessa e produzione senza rivelare il finale.

# Heartbreaker у Монако: місця зйомок романтичної комедії

Монте-Карло ніби створене для романтичної комедії: розкішні готелі, бутики, красиві автомобілі й Середземне море. Проте в L'Arnacœur потрібно не знайти кохання, а зупинити весілля.

У фільмі Паскаля Шомейля 2010 року Ромен Дюріс грає Алекса Ліппі, професійного спокусника, який розлучає пари за допомогою сестри Мелані та її чоловіка Марка. Він стверджує, що втручається лише тоді, коли жінка нещаслива. Але заможний батько доручає йому завадити весіллю доньки Жульєтт із британським нареченим.

Жульєтт, яку грає Ванесса Параді, незалежна, розумна й начебто щаслива. Вона не надто цікавиться чарівним незнайомцем, а до весілля залишилися лічені дні. Алекс приїздить у Монако й організовує дедалі складніші спроби завоювати її довіру.

Розкіш стає сценою професії, побудованої на ілюзіях. При цьому Монако не просто вигадане тло: Monte-Carlo Bay, площа казино та Salle Garnier справді приймали знімальну групу. Цей гід пропонує поїздку з Ментона, відділяючи документовані місця від попередніх ідентифікацій. Тут є зав'язка й історія зйомок, але немає розкриття фіналу.

## 1. Discover L’Arnacœur

Original title: L’Arnacœur

International title: Heartbreaker

Director: Pascal Chaumeil

French release: 17 March 2010

Starring: Romain Duris, Vanessa Paradis, Julie Ferrier, François Damiens and Andrew Lincoln

Screenplay: Laurent Zeitoun, Jeremy Doner and Yoann Gromb

Cinematography: Thierry Arbogast

Music: Klaus Badelt

Genre: Romantic comedy

Running time: Approximately 105 minutes in the French theatrical version

The film follows a professional relationship-breaker whose latest assignment challenges his own carefully established rules.

Alex's professional confidence, elaborate deceptions and carefully controlled performances make him a natural romantic-comedy protagonist.

Juliette, meanwhile, resists his attempts to influence her.

Their interactions unfold amid Monaco's luxury hotels, shopping districts, gardens and waterfront.

### Why does the film work so well in Monaco?

The characters inhabit an environment where almost anything seems possible if someone has enough money.

Hotel suites, extravagant events and luxury shopping provide the physical setting for Alex's elaborate scheme.

Yet the film's romantic question is surprisingly simple.

Can affection be created through manipulation?

Or does genuine love require the freedom to make one's own choices?

That contrast between elaborate appearances and authentic feelings makes Monaco an especially effective setting.

### Where to find the film

The film's streaming and physical-media availability varies by country.

For film information, consult [Unifrance's film record](https://en.unifrance.org/movie/30627/heartbreaker) and its production press kit. Availability must be checked for your country; a film record is not a streaming offer.

Titre international : Heartbreaker. Réalisation : Pascal Chaumeil. Sortie française : 17 mars 2010. Distribution : Romain Duris, Vanessa Paradis, Julie Ferrier, François Damiens et Andrew Lincoln. Scénario : Laurent Zeitoun, Jeremy Doner et Yoann Gromb. Image : Thierry Arbogast. Musique : Klaus Badelt. Comédie romantique d'environ 105 minutes dans sa version française de cinéma.

Alex possède assurance, déguisements et mensonges bien préparés ; Juliette résiste à ses tentatives d'influence. Leurs échanges se déroulent entre hôtels, commerces, jardins et littoral. Le film confronte un dispositif très organisé à une question simple : l'affection peut-elle être fabriquée, ou suppose-t-elle la liberté de choisir ?

### Pourquoi Monaco fonctionne si bien

Le cadre semble offrir toutes les possibilités à qui dispose d'argent : suites, événements et achats luxueux rendent crédible le dispositif d'Alex. Ce contraste entre sophistication des apparences et sincérité des sentiments sert particulièrement la comédie.

La disponibilité en vidéo ou en ligne varie selon les pays. La [fiche Unifrance](https://en.unifrance.org/movie/30627/heartbreaker) et son dossier de presse documentent le film, mais ne constituent pas une offre de diffusion actuelle. Vérifiez la distribution pour votre pays.

## 3. Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort: the heart of Heartbreaker

Address: 40 Avenue Princesse Grace, Monaco.

This is the strongest individual filming-location connection in the entire guide.

Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort is a luxury property overlooking the Mediterranean, with gardens, terraces, swimming facilities and extensive views towards the coast.

In Heartbreaker, it provides the hotel setting in which Juliette stays while Alex attempts to complete his assignment.

Its rooms, shared spaces and surrounding resort environment become central to the romantic comedy.

### Why was it selected?

According to a Monaco newspaper interview with Monte-Carlo Société des Bains de Mer, Pascal Chaumeil had previously visited the hotel personally and chose it for his film.

The property offered a particularly convincing environment for a story about wealthy international visitors.

The hotel was modern enough to suit the film's contemporary setting, but luxurious enough to create a sense of almost limitless possibility.

### An unusual piece of tourism history

After the film became successful internationally, the hotel operator introduced a temporary L’Arnacœur accommodation package.

It included opportunities for guests to experience locations associated with filming.

The promotion was particularly aimed at audiences in markets where Romain Duris and Vanessa Paradis were popular.

This is a rare example of a film inspiring a dedicated hotel experience at the real location where it was made.

Important: The special package was a past promotion, not a currently confirmed offer.

### What can you see today?

Monte-Carlo Bay remains an operating luxury hotel.

Its restaurants and bars include Blue Bay Marcel Ravin, L'Orange Verte and Blue Gin.

Some facilities are seasonal, while others are reserved for hotel guests.

You may be able to arrange a restaurant or bar visit without staying overnight, but confirm the venue's current policy first.

Don't assume that hotel rooms, pools, private gardens or filming interiors can be freely entered.

### Our recommendation

If you want one meaningful Heartbreaker location, choose Monte-Carlo Bay.

But plan it as a legitimate hotel, restaurant or bar visit rather than trying to enter private guest areas.

[Official Monte-Carlo Bay website](https://www.montecarlosbm.com/en/hotel-monaco/monte-carlo-bay-hotel-resort)

## 3. Monte-Carlo Bay : le cœur du film

Adresse : 40 avenue Princesse Grace, Monaco. C'est le lien individuel le plus solide du guide. Cet hôtel de luxe, tourné vers la Méditerranée, fournit le cadre du séjour de Juliette et de nombreuses scènes avec Alex. Chambres, espaces communs et environnement du resort participent à la comédie.

### Pourquoi cet hôtel ?

Selon l'interview de la représentante SBM, Pascal Chaumeil connaissait personnellement l'établissement et l'avait choisi pour son film. Son caractère contemporain et luxueux convenait à l'univers de visiteurs fortunés, où presque tout paraît possible.

### Une promotion devenue histoire touristique

Après le succès du film, la SBM proposa un forfait temporaire L'Arnacœur, comprenant un séjour et une découverte de lieux de tournage. L'interview évoque notamment l'intérêt du public asiatique pour les deux acteurs. Il s'agit d'une ancienne promotion, pas d'une formule actuellement confirmée.

### Que voir aujourd'hui ?

Monte-Carlo Bay demeure un établissement hôtelier, non un musée permanent du film. Parmi les adresses associées au complexe figurent Blue Bay Marcel Ravin, L'Orange Verte et Blue Gin ; confirmez leurs activités, horaires et conditions actuelles. Certaines installations sont saisonnières ou réservées aux résidents.

Un restaurant ou un bar peut éventuellement accepter une réservation extérieure, mais cela ne donne pas accès aux chambres, piscines, jardins privés ni intérieurs utilisés par le tournage. Si vous ne retenez qu'un lieu du film, choisissez celui-ci, en organisant une visite légitime et confirmée, jamais une intrusion dans les espaces des clients.

[Site officiel de Monte-Carlo Bay](https://www.montecarlosbm.com/en/hotel-monaco/monte-carlo-bay-hotel-resort)

## 3. Monte-Carlo Bay: il cuore di Heartbreaker

Indirizzo: 40 avenue Princesse Grace, Monaco. È il singolo collegamento più solido della guida. Il resort sul Mediterraneo offre l'ambientazione dell'hotel di Juliette: camere, spazi comuni e contesto costiero partecipano alla commedia e ai tentativi di Alex.

### Perché fu scelto?

Secondo l'intervista alla rappresentante SBM, Pascal Chaumeil conosceva personalmente l'hotel e lo volle per il film. L'ambiente contemporaneo e lussuoso si adattava a una storia di visitatori facoltosi, per i quali ogni possibilità sembra aperta.

### Una promozione entrata nella storia turistica

Dopo il successo del film, SBM creò temporaneamente un pacchetto L'Arnacœur con soggiorno e scoperta dei luoghi di ripresa. L'intervista ricorda anche l'interesse del pubblico asiatico per Duris e Paradis. È una promozione passata, non un'offerta oggi confermata.

### Cosa si può vedere?

Monte-Carlo Bay è una struttura alberghiera attiva, non un museo del film. Tra i locali associati al complesso figurano Blue Bay Marcel Ravin, L'Orange Verte e Blue Gin: verifica attività, orari e politiche attuali. Alcuni servizi sono stagionali o riservati agli ospiti.

Bar e ristoranti possono eventualmente accogliere prenotazioni esterne, senza dare accesso a camere, piscine, giardini privati o interni utilizzati dal cinema. Se scegli un solo luogo del film, questo è il più significativo: organizza però una visita legittima e confermata, senza entrare negli spazi degli ospiti.

[Sito ufficiale di Monte-Carlo Bay](https://www.montecarlosbm.com/en/hotel-monaco/monte-carlo-bay-hotel-resort)

## 3. Monte-Carlo Bay: серце Heartbreaker

Адреса: 40 avenue Princesse Grace, Monaco. Це найпереконливіший окремий зв'язок у гіді. Курортний готель над Середземним морем стає місцем перебування Жульєтт; номери, спільні простори й навколишній краєвид беруть участь у комедії та плані Алекса.

### Чому обрали цей готель?

За інтерв'ю представниці SBM, Паскаль Шомейль раніше особисто відвідував заклад і вибрав його для фільму. Сучасне розкішне середовище пасувало історії про заможних міжнародних гостей, яким усе здається можливим.

### Колишня туристична пропозиція

Після успіху фільму SBM тимчасово створила пакет L'Arnacœur із проживанням і знайомством із місцями зйомок. Інтерв'ю також згадує зацікавлення азійської аудиторії двома акторами. Це історична акція, не підтверджена чинна пропозиція.

### Що можна побачити?

Monte-Carlo Bay працює як готель, не як постійний музей фільму. Серед пов'язаних із комплексом закладів — Blue Bay Marcel Ravin, L'Orange Verte та Blue Gin; їхню поточну роботу, години й правила слід уточнювати. Частина послуг сезонна або лише для гостей.

Бар чи ресторан може приймати сторонні бронювання, але це не відкриває доступу до номерів, басейнів, приватних садів або знімальних інтер'єрів. Якщо обирати одне місце фільму, Bay найзмістовніший. Плануйте законний підтверджений візит, а не проникнення в простір гостей.

## 4. Place du Casino: the glamorous public stage

Location: Place du Casino, Monte Carlo.

Casino Square is one of Monaco's most recognisable public spaces.

The Casino de Monte-Carlo, Hôtel de Paris and surrounding luxury shopping establishments create an instantly identifiable setting.

It's also one of the principal urban areas used for Heartbreaker.

### The shopping scene

Specialist scene-location research identifies an approximately 21-minute sequence in which Juliette enters a luxury shop in the Casino Square area.

The location is associated with a former Céline boutique.

However, shop locations and commercial tenants have changed since the film was made.

Don't assume that the present boutique layout reproduces the 2009 scene.

### Why the square works on screen

Casino Square immediately communicates money, elegance and social status.

A character doesn't need to explain that they're moving through an expensive part of Monaco.

The architecture says it for them.

This creates an amusing contrast with Alex's profession.

He makes a living by staging apparently spontaneous emotional encounters.

And he performs them in one of the world's most carefully curated luxury environments.

### Visiting today

Casino Square is accessible as a public space, although events, security arrangements and temporary works can affect movement.

The square was substantially redesigned in 2020, so the landscape differs from its appearance in the film.

The permanent architectural façades are more dependable points of comparison than trees, paving, street furniture or shop signs.

Suggested time: 20–40 minutes.

## 5. Opéra de Monte-Carlo: elegance as performance

Location: Salle Garnier, Place du Casino.

The Opéra de Monte-Carlo is housed within the Casino de Monte-Carlo complex.

Its historic Salle Garnier is one of the Principality's most celebrated performance spaces.

The room was designed by Charles Garnier, the architect associated with the Paris Opéra.

### The connection with Heartbreaker

The venue is identified in independent filming records and in statements from the Monte-Carlo SBM group.

Specialist scene research also identifies a sequence in which Alex emerges from the opera-house area towards Casino Square.

### A setting within a setting

This is an especially appropriate location for a comedy about someone who constantly performs.

Alex adopts identities, invents circumstances and produces emotional scenes to influence others.

The opera house is literally a building devoted to performance.

The connection is thematic, even though the film uses it as a real location.

### Can you visit?

The opera is an active cultural venue, not an unrestricted museum.

Access depends on ticketed performances, tours or specific public-opening arrangements.

The exterior Casino Square area can be appreciated without entering the opera.

For interior access, check the current programme.

[Official Opéra de Monte-Carlo programme](https://www.opera.mc/en/)

## 6. Boulevard d'Italie: the less theatrical side of Monaco

Location: Boulevard d'Italie, Monaco.

Not all of Heartbreaker takes place in luxury hotel interiors.

The film also uses ordinary urban streets, car journeys and more spontaneous-looking encounters.

Several specialist filming-location records place scenes around Boulevard d'Italie.

One record identifies a sequence involving Alex and Juliette near number 15.

Another associates a car incident with a location farther along the boulevard.

### Why is this interesting?

Because the film depends on making planned actions appear accidental.

The surrounding streets offer a believable everyday environment for Alex's work.

Unlike Casino Square, they don't exist principally to impress visitors.

They contain the practical urban fabric of a living city.

### Can you follow the exact sequence?

You can walk along lawful public pavements, but the film's vehicle movements should not be treated as a pedestrian route.

The present traffic arrangements may differ from those in 2009.

There's no need to recreate a car chase, stop on the road or photograph from unsafe positions.

For an ordinary visitor, Boulevard d'Italie works best as an optional stop rather than the centre of the itinerary.

## 6. Boulevard d'Italie : un Monaco moins théâtral

Le film ne se limite pas aux hôtels. Le catalogue L2TC propose des scènes de rue près des numéros 15 et 19 du boulevard d'Italie. Ces repères sont attribués aux contributeurs et restent à comparer à la copie exacte du film, pas des points de caméra certifiés.

Les rues ordinaires donnent de la crédibilité aux rencontres organisées par Alex : elles appartiennent à une ville vivante plutôt qu'à un décor conçu seulement pour impressionner. Pour un visiteur, cette extension est facultative.

On peut suivre les trottoirs publics autorisés, jamais les mouvements automobiles du film comme s'ils formaient un parcours piéton. Circulation et aménagements ont pu changer. Ne vous arrêtez pas sur la chaussée et ne recréez ni poursuite ni prise de vue dangereuse.

Segui soltanto marciapiedi pubblici consentiti. I movimenti delle auto nel film non costituiscono un itinerario pedonale; circolazione e viabilità possono essere cambiate. Non fermarti sulla strada e non ricreare inseguimenti o fotografie pericolose.

## 7. The harbour: Monaco beyond the casino

The supplied location list proposes Quai Antoine Ier, by Port Hercule, the harbour below Monte Carlo and Monaco-Ville. Its exact screen connection could not be corroborated in the sources read for this guide. Treat it as optional harbour context, not a verified filming stop.

The waterfront offers an interesting contrast to the enclosed hotel interiors and formal casino district.

### What to notice

The scale of the harbour.

The relationship between luxury yachts and working port infrastructure.

The buildings rising around the water.

The difference between the polished resort image and the everyday movement required to support it.

### Why include it?

The harbour helps visitors see Monaco as an active city, not merely a collection of luxury establishments. An actual film-frame match is still needed before publishing any precise camera viewpoint on Quai Antoine Ier. No place card or map point is assigned to this unverified scene suggestion.

For a short outing from Menton, this stop is optional.

A visitor interested mainly in the central romantic scenes may prefer to concentrate on Casino Square and Monte-Carlo Bay.

## 7. Le port : Monaco au-delà du casino

Le manuscrit propose Quai Antoine Ier, près du Port Hercule, sous Monte-Carlo et Monaco-Ville. Son lien exact avec une scène n'a pas pu être corroboré dans les sources lues. C'est donc un contexte portuaire facultatif, pas un lieu de tournage vérifié.

On peut y regarder l'échelle du bassin, le rapport entre yachts et infrastructures de travail, les bâtiments et les mouvements nécessaires au fonctionnement de cette ville. Ce contraste avec les intérieurs d'hôtel et le quartier du casino est intéressant en lui-même.

Une comparaison réelle avec les images reste indispensable avant de publier un point précis de caméra. Aucune fiche de lieu ni coordonnée n'est créée pour cette suggestion non vérifiée. Pour une courte excursion, mieux vaut privilégier la place du Casino et Monte-Carlo Bay.

## 7. Порт: Монако за межами казино

Рукопис пропонує Quai Antoine Ier біля Port Hercule, нижче Монте-Карло та Monaco-Ville. Точний зв'язок зі сценою не вдалося підтвердити в прочитаних джерелах. Це необов'язковий портовий контекст, не перевірений знімальний майданчик.

Подивіться на масштаб гавані, співіснування яхт і робочої інфраструктури, будівлі та щоденний рух, що підтримує місто. Контраст із готельними інтер'єрами й кварталом казино цікавий сам собою.

До публікації точної позиції камери потрібне реальне порівняння з кадрами. Для цієї неперевіреної гіпотези не створюються картка чи координата. За короткої поїздки краще зосередитися на площі казино й Monte-Carlo Bay.

## 8. The famous dance scene: not filmed in Monaco

One of the film's most memorable romantic-comedy sequences is associated with Dirty Dancing.

It would be tempting to assume that the scene was filmed inside one of Monaco's glamorous establishments.

The contributor catalogue L2TC identifies Chez Gégène, a traditional guinguette at Joinville-le-Pont near Paris, as the actual location. This is an attributed scene identification, not a fresh comparison of the complete film with production records.

This is an important distinction.

A scene may belong to the story of a visit to Monaco without being filmed there.

The production used locations in multiple regions of France, as well as Morocco and Monaco.

### What does this reveal?

Film geography is constructed through editing.

The audience experiences a coherent sequence of events.

But the buildings used for individual scenes may be hundreds of kilometres apart.

For an accurate visitor guide, the location where a scene was shot matters more than where the script suggests it occurred.

And in this case, the famous dance is not an additional Monte Carlo attraction.
fr:
## 8. La danse célèbre : pas un décor monégasque

L'une des séquences les plus connues fait référence à Dirty Dancing. Il serait tentant de l'attribuer à un établissement de Monaco. Le catalogue contributif L2TC l'identifie pourtant chez Gégène, guinguette de Joinville-le-Pont près de Paris.

C'est une identification attribuée, pas une nouvelle comparaison intégrale du film et des documents de production. Elle rappelle néanmoins qu'une scène appartenant à un séjour fictif à Monaco peut être tournée ailleurs. La production combine plusieurs régions françaises, le Maroc et Monaco.

Le montage crée une géographie cohérente pour le spectateur à partir de bâtiments parfois très éloignés. Dans un guide de voyage, distinguer lieu du récit et lieu de tournage est essentiel. Cette danse n'ajoute donc aucune attraction à la promenade monégasque.
it:
## 8. Il ballo famoso: non fu girato a Monaco

Una delle sequenze più note richiama Dirty Dancing. Potrebbe sembrare ambientata in uno dei locali eleganti del Principato, ma il catalogo collaborativo L2TC la identifica a Chez Gégène, guinguette di Joinville-le-Pont vicino a Parigi.

È un'identificazione attribuita, non una nuova verifica integrale di film e documenti di produzione. Ricorda comunque che una scena appartenente al soggiorno narrativo a Monaco può essere girata altrove. La produzione combina regioni francesi, Marocco e Monaco.

Il montaggio costruisce una geografia coerente con edifici a volte lontanissimi. Una guida deve distinguere luogo della storia e luogo delle riprese: il ballo non aggiunge dunque un'attrazione alla passeggiata monegasca.
uk:
## 8. Відомий танець: знятий не в Монако

Одна з найпам'ятніших сцен відсилає до Dirty Dancing. Легко припустити, що це заклад князівства, але спільнотний каталог L2TC визначає Chez Gégène, ґенґет у Joinville-le-Pont біля Парижа.

Це атрибутована ідентифікація, не нова повна перевірка фільму й виробничих документів. Вона нагадує: епізод вигаданого перебування в Монако може зніматися деінде. Виробництво поєднало французькі регіони, Марокко та Монако.

Монтаж створює єдину географію з часом дуже віддалених будівель. Для туристичного гіда важливо відрізняти місце оповіді й знімальний простір. Танець не додає нової пам'ятки до прогулянки Монте-Карло.

## 9. Monte-Carlo Beach: a second luxury location

The Monaco hotel operator also confirms that filming took place at Monte-Carlo Beach.

Despite its name and Monaco operator, the property is in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, France, just beyond Monaco's eastern border. It is distinct from Monte-Carlo Bay, and its restaurant and beach facilities have their own access rules.

### Should you include it in your visit?

Only if it fits your interests and current access arrangements.

Monte-Carlo Beach is a commercial resort property, not a freely accessible historic public promenade.

Its restaurants, beach club and facilities have seasonal rules.

An ordinary visitor can appreciate the surrounding coast without expecting admission to private hotel services.

### What remains to verify?

The operator's interview confirms filming at the property, but the specific scenes and camera positions are not fully established in the sources reviewed for this guide.

For that reason, this is an optional production-history location rather than an essential stop.
fr:
## 9. Monte-Carlo Beach : une seconde adresse de luxe

La représentante SBM confirme aussi des prises de vues à Monte-Carlo Beach. Malgré son nom et son opérateur monégasque, l'établissement se situe à Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, en France, au-delà de la frontière orientale. Ce n'est pas Monte-Carlo Bay.

### L'inclure ou non ?

Seulement selon vos intérêts et des conditions d'accès confirmées. Hôtel, restaurants, plage et club relèvent d'une exploitation commerciale avec saisonnalité et règles propres ; ce n'est pas une promenade historique publique libre d'accès.

Le littoral environnant peut s'apprécier sans admission aux services privés. L'interview confirme la présence du tournage, mais pas chaque scène ni son point de caméra. Cette adresse reste donc un complément d'histoire de production, pas une étape indispensable ou une promesse d'ouverture aujourd'hui.
it:
## 9. Monte-Carlo Beach: un'altra struttura di lusso

La rappresentante SBM conferma riprese anche a Monte-Carlo Beach. Nonostante nome e gestione monegaschi, l'hotel è a Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, in Francia, oltre il confine orientale. Non è Monte-Carlo Bay.

### Vale la pena aggiungerlo?

Soltanto secondo interessi e accessi confermati. Hotel, ristoranti, spiaggia e club sono servizi commerciali con stagionalità e regole proprie, non un lungomare storico pubblico con ingresso libero.

Si può apprezzare la costa circostante senza aspettarsi l'ammissione ai servizi privati. L'intervista documenta la presenza della produzione, non tutte le scene o le posizioni di ripresa. Rimane una tappa facoltativa di storia cinematografica, non una promessa di apertura o una visita indispensabile.
uk:
## 9. Monte-Carlo Beach: друга розкішна адреса

Представниця SBM підтверджує зйомки й у Monte-Carlo Beach. Попри назву та монакського оператора, готель розташований у Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, Франція, за східним кордоном Монако. Це не Monte-Carlo Bay.

### Чи додавати його до прогулянки?

Лише за власним інтересом і підтвердженим доступом. Готель, ресторани, пляж і клуб — комерційні послуги зі своїми сезонними правилами, не історична громадська набережна з вільним входом.

Навколишнє узбережжя можна оцінити без доступу до приватних послуг. Інтерв'ю підтверджує присутність групи, але не кожну сцену чи ракурс. Отже, це додаткова адреса історії виробництва, не обов'язкова зупинка й не обіцянка відкриття сьогодні.

## 12. Getting to Monaco from Menton

The regional TER is usually the simplest way to reach Monaco without a car.

The train journey from central Menton to Monaco-Monte-Carlo generally takes around 10–15 minutes.

But the actual total journey includes reaching the station, exiting Monaco's underground railway complex and continuing to your chosen location.

### Before leaving

Check the service for your date.

Confirm the correct station exit for Casino Square.

Review current pedestrian access and public transport connections.

If you have a restaurant reservation at Monte-Carlo Bay, allow enough time to reach the hotel.

And check the return train before committing to a late dinner.

### Do you need a car?

Not for the main itinerary.

Public transport is normally more convenient than parking in central Monaco, especially if your visit includes only Casino Square and the hotel district.

For visitors staying in Menton, the short rail connection is one of the best reasons to treat Monaco as a day trip rather than changing accommodation.

Avant de partir, vérifiez les trains à votre date, la bonne sortie pour la place du Casino, les accès piétons et les liaisons locales. Prévoyez une marge pour une réservation à Monte-Carlo Bay et contrôlez le retour avant de réserver un dîner tardif.

La voiture n'est pas nécessaire pour le parcours principal. Le transport public évite les contraintes de stationnement ; la liaison courte permet une excursion depuis Menton sans changer d'hébergement. Aucune fréquence, heure de dernier train ou disponibilité n'est garantie ici.

## 13. Can you recreate the film's romantic hotel experience?

You can visit some real places used in the production, subject to their current commercial arrangements.

But that is different from booking a guaranteed Heartbreaker experience.

### The former themed hotel package

Following the success of the movie, Monte-Carlo SBM offered a special L’Arnacœur package.

That offer is part of the film's tourism history.

It should not be presented as currently available without fresh confirmation from the hotel.

### A contemporary alternative

Visitors can investigate restaurant or bar reservations at Monte-Carlo Bay.

The Blue Gin lounge and other hotel facilities may provide an opportunity to enjoy the Mediterranean setting.

Their hours, menus, pricing and access policies can change.

Check directly before visiting.

### Keep expectations realistic

The hotel is operating normally, not functioning as a permanent museum of the production.

A particular guest room may have changed.

Props and costumes have been removed.

And a booking at a restaurant doesn't provide access to private filming interiors.

The attraction is experiencing the real setting, not expecting the movie to have remained frozen in place since 2009.

## 13. Peut-on retrouver l'expérience romantique de l'hôtel ?

Certains lieux de production peuvent se découvrir selon leurs conditions commerciales actuelles. Ce n'est pas une expérience L'Arnacœur garantie.

L'ancien forfait thématique appartient à l'histoire touristique du film. Ne le réservez pas comme une offre existante sans confirmation récente de l'hôtel. Une réservation contemporaine au Blue Gin ou à un restaurant peut offrir un moment dans le cadre méditerranéen, mais horaires, menus, prix et admission évoluent.

L'établissement fonctionne comme un hôtel normal. Chambres, décorations et installations ont changé, les accessoires du film ne sont pas une exposition permanente, et un repas ne donne pas accès aux intérieurs privés. L'intérêt est le cadre réel, pas la promesse d'un film resté figé.

Il vecchio pacchetto tematico appartiene alla storia del turismo cinematografico; non presentarlo come prenotabile senza nuova conferma dell'hotel. Una prenotazione contemporanea al Blue Gin o in un ristorante può offrire il panorama mediterraneo, ma orari, prezzi, menu e ingresso cambiano.

L'albergo funziona normalmente. Camere e decorazioni possono essere diverse, gli oggetti di scena non sono un'esposizione permanente e un pranzo non concede accesso a interni privati. L'interesse è il luogo reale, non un film congelato al momento delle riprese.

## 13. Чи можна повторити романтичний досвід готелю?

Деякі місця виробництва можна відвідати за чинними комерційними правилами. Це не гарантований пакет Heartbreaker.

Старий тематичний пакет належить до історії кінематографічного туризму. Не представляйте його чинним без нового підтвердження готелю. Сучасне бронювання Blue Gin чи ресторану може дати нагоду побачити середземноморське середовище, але години, меню, ціни й допуск змінюються.

Готель працює звичайним чином. Номери та декор могли змінитися, реквізит не є постійною виставкою, а обід не відкриває приватних інтер'єрів. Привабливе саме реальне місце, не обіцянка застиглого в часі фільму.

## 14. What has changed since filming?

The film's production belongs to 2009; a precise summer schedule is not asserted here.

Monaco has changed since then.

Casino Square was substantially redesigned in 2020.

Luxury boutiques have moved or changed ownership.

Road arrangements have evolved.

New buildings and public spaces have appeared.

The hotels themselves have continued updating their rooms, gardens and commercial services.

### How should film enthusiasts compare the locations?

Start with permanent architecture.

Look at building proportions, major entrances, façades and the relationship between streets.

Use temporary details such as shopfront signs and furniture cautiously.

And remember that timestamps can differ between theatrical and international cuts.

A specialist database's timestamp should be checked against the exact version of the film being viewed.

## 14. Ce qui a changé depuis le tournage

Commencez vos comparaisons par l'architecture durable : proportions, façades, grandes entrées et rapports entre les rues. Enseignes et mobilier demandent davantage de prudence. Les minutages varient aussi selon les montages ; contrôlez toujours la version utilisée par un catalogue.

Per confrontare i luoghi comincia dall'architettura durevole: proporzioni, facciate, grandi ingressi e rapporti tra strade. Insegne e arredi sono meno affidabili. Anche i minutaggi cambiano secondo il montaggio: verifica l'edizione usata dal catalogo.

## 16. What makes Heartbreaker different from other Monaco films?

Monaco frequently appears on screen as a place of international wealth.

In James Bond films, that wealth may provide the setting for espionage or criminal intrigue.

In historical dramas, Monaco becomes a symbol of political authority and celebrity.

Heartbreaker uses the same glamorous environment for comedy.

### Luxury as a theatrical stage

Alex needs to control appearances.

He arranges encounters and invents convincing identities.

The expensive hotels and elegant streets make those performances possible.

The film's humour comes partly from how carefully everything has to be organised behind the scenes.

### Romance versus control

The central relationship becomes interesting because Juliette refuses to behave exactly as Alex expects.

Her independence challenges his professional assumptions.

The film gradually shifts from a calculated assignment towards a less predictable emotional situation.

The Monaco setting reinforces this contrast.

Everything around the characters appears carefully designed.

Their feelings are much harder to manage.

## Frequently asked questions

### Was Heartbreaker filmed in Monaco?

Yes. Much of the production took place in Monaco, including Monte-Carlo Bay, Casino Square and Salle Garnier.

### What is the French title of Heartbreaker?

L’Arnacœur, released in France on 17 March 2010.

### Who stars in Heartbreaker?

Romain Duris and Vanessa Paradis, alongside Julie Ferrier, François Damiens and Andrew Lincoln.

### Which Monaco hotel appears in the film?

Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, at 40 Avenue Princesse Grace.

### Can you visit the hotel?

It remains an operating luxury hotel. Some restaurants and bars may accept non-resident reservations, while guest and leisure facilities have separate access restrictions.

### Can you book the original Heartbreaker package?

The hotel previously offered a themed package after the film's release. Its present availability has not been confirmed.

### Does Casino Square appear in the movie?

Yes. Production reporting and specialist location research identify sequences in the area.

### Was the famous dance filmed in Monaco?

Location research identifies Chez Gégène at Joinville-le-Pont near Paris, rather than a Monaco venue.

### How long does the film-location visit take?

Allow three to five hours in Monaco, excluding the train journey, depending on which stops and services you choose.

### Is the walk suitable for visitors with limited mobility?

Monaco has significant elevation changes. Pedestrian lifts and local transport can help, but the proposed route has not been independently audited as step-free.

### Is Heartbreaker a good film to watch before a Monaco trip?

Yes, particularly if you enjoy romantic comedies and want to recognise real Monaco hotels, shopping districts and cultural buildings.

It explains the premise and production history without revealing the film's ending.

## Final thoughts: Monaco as a romantic comedy set

Many films use Monaco as a shorthand for luxury.

Heartbreaker makes something more playful out of that image.

Its expensive hotels, elegant streets and beautiful coastal views become the setting for a man whose entire profession depends on creating illusions.

But the more carefully Alex plans his assignment, the less predictable his own feelings become.

The film's Monaco locations are genuine.

Monte-Carlo Bay really hosted the production.

Casino Square and Salle Garnier appeared on screen.

And the surrounding streets became part of the romantic comedy's elaborate machinery.

For visitors staying in Menton, these places offer an enjoyable cultural excursion.

You don't need to book a luxury hotel room or recreate the characters' adventures.

Explore Casino Square.

Discover the opera's architecture.

Enjoy the view towards the Mediterranean.

And if you want to experience the main filming location more closely, arrange an appropriate visit to Monte-Carlo Bay.

The film may be about a professional heartbreaker.

But its Riviera setting remains one of its most memorable attractions.
